components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #DDE1E0; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 20px; background: rgba(245,247,246,0.6); border-bottom: 1px solid #DDE1E0; } .ds-card-label { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #6B7674; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #1DA85A; } .ds-card-body { padding: 20px; } .ds-card-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(221,225,224,0.6); font-size: 14px; color: #1C1F1E; } .ds-card-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 20px; border-top: 1px solid #DDE1E0; background: rgba(29,168,90,0.05); } .ds-card-footer-label { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #6B7674; } .ds-card-footer-value { font-family: 'Spectral', Georgia, serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #1DA85A; } .ds-dot-hadir { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1DA85A; flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview:
SIGAP's visual system is a digital attendance ledger that is alive — names appear one by one, status dots light up green or red, timestamps tick. The system rejects the generic SaaS landing page. Instead, the product demonstrates itself: the hero IS the product working, not a description of it.

The palette is operational, not decorative. Green means verified presence. Red means absence. Amber means late. These are semantic colors of attendance status, and the entire interface is built from them. The deep green accent panel in the hero is the institutional voice: calm, authoritative, the school speaking.

Density is high but legible. Mono type carries data. Serif carries headlines. Sans carries body. Three voices for three audiences: institution, people, data.
keyCharacteristics: Ledger-first: every surface shows data in rows, not marketing cards
Semantic color: green/red/amber carry meaning, never decorative
Mono for data, serif for institution, sans for people
Live motion: staggered reveals, pulse indicators
No social proof: the mechanism is the proof
Bahasa Indonesia for all user-facing text

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Green, red, and amber are reserved for attendance status meanings. Never use them decoratively.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The deep teal-green accent panel appears once per page — in the hero. It is the institutional voice.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif speaks for the institution. Sans speaks for people. Mono speaks for data. Never mix their roles.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. Borders and tonal layering create hierarchy. Shadows reserved for the single live element.

dos: Do show the product working — live data, staggered reveals, status dots
Do use green/red/amber only for their semantic attendance meanings
Do use mono type for all data values
Do use the card header + body + footer structure for all data containers
Do keep the hero split 5/7 — green panel left, data right
Do use Bahasa Indonesia for all user-facing text
donts: Don't use green, red, or amber as decorative colors
Don't add shadows to cards at rest
Don't use gradient transitions between sections
Don't add testimonials, trusted-by logos, pricing tables, or social proof
Don't use serif for data values or mono for headlines
Don't animate the nav background on scroll
Don't use real teacher photos in the hero
